title: Deckhand
description: Deckhand's runs, webhooks, GitHub, models, egress, sandboxes and services (docs/setup.md, Metrics).

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Runs going: their sandbox started, or being prepared (the acting orchestrator's).

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Tasks waiting, for any reason.

panels.title: Max parallel
panels.description: MAX_PARALLEL.

panels.title: Started (24 h)
panels.description: Runs started in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Errors (24 h)
panels.description: Share of the runs ended in the last 24 hours that ended in an error; no data without any.

panels.title: Needs input (24 h)
panels.description: Runs ended in the last 24 hours waiting for the maintainer's answers.

panels.title: Runs going and queued, against MAX_PARALLEL
panels.description: Running runs, the tasks waiting by why (slot, repo, pickup, pause, after, answers), MAX_PARALLEL, and the runs whose end waits for the store (their summary, the queue, their state's removal), each holding a slot.

panels.title: Runs started, by mode
panels.description: Runs started per hour, by mode (custom: a repo's own).

panels.title: Runs ended, by outcome
panels.description: Runs ended per hour: ok, needs-input, error, cancelled.

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: From leaving the queue to the run's end, runs that ended ok or needing input.

panels.title: Runs started, by kind and agent
panels.description: work, light, review, fix, ci-fix, conflict, auto-pickup; per hour.

panels.title: Webhooks received
panels.description: GitHub's deliveries at edge, by result, per minute.

panels.title: Deliveries processed
panels.description: Verified deliveries the orchestrator handled: taken, ignored, refused; per minute.

panels.title: GitHub's rate limit left
panels.description: Calls left in the lowest rate limit, as a share of its window, by resource.

panels.title: GitHub API calls
panels.description: Calls to GitHub's API by status, per minute.

panels.title: GitHub API latency
panels.description: p90 of GitHub's answers, to their headers, by caller.

panels.title: Git operations
panels.description: Clones, mirror updates, fetches and pushes by result, per hour; pushes refused by why.

panels.title: Model calls, by status
panels.description: The agents' API calls through the models service, per minute, by provider and status (429: a limit, 529: overloaded).

panels.title: Fallbacks
panels.description: Runs put back for the next entry of FALLBACKS, per hour.

panels.title: Plans' usage
panels.description: How much of each plan's window the runs used.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens the answers said they used, per minute, by provider and direction.

panels.title: Model call duration
panels.description: p90 of a call's length, its answer streamed whole.

panels.title: Streams cut short and logins refreshed
panels.description: Answers the provider cut short; plans' logins refreshed by result; per hour.

panels.title: Connections denied
panels.description: Connections the egress proxy refused, by why, per minute (the hosts are in its log lines).

panels.title: Connections allowed
panels.description: Connections let through, by source, per minute; open connections.

panels.title: Egress traffic
panels.description: Bytes through the proxy by direction.

panels.title: Cache requests
panels.description: Requests to cached_hosts by result, per minute.

panels.title: Cache size
panels.description: What the cache keeps (and is writing), against EGRESS_CACHE_MAX.

panels.title: Egress policy and gateway
panels.description: p90 of the orchestrator's egress policy; the runs' calls passed on that failed (5xx, unreachable), per minute.

panels.title: Network isolated
panels.description: Kubernetes: the network probe's last verdict. Not isolated refuses every run; no data on Docker.

panels.title: Sandboxes running
panels.description: On Kubernetes, Pending pods too.

panels.title: Sandboxes running, by engine
panels.description: By the container engine their run has.

panels.title: Sandbox start time
panels.description: From a start asked to its sandbox running.

panels.title: Starts failed
panels.description: Sandbox starts that failed, by why, per hour.

panels.title: Network probes
panels.description: The network probe's verdicts, per hour.

panels.title: Image builds
panels.description: Repo images built, by result, per hour (one already built is reused, not counted).

panels.title: Image build time
panels.description: p50 and p90 of the builds' length, failed ones too.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Each copy's resident memory.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Each copy's CPU, in cores.

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: p99 of each copy's event loop delay.

panels.title: Leases
panels.description: 1 on the copy holding each lease (orchestrator, runner, edge/redeliveries); the max is 0 when no copy holds it.

panels.title: Lease takeovers
panels.description: Times a copy took a lease, per hour: a steady rate is copies taking it from each other.

panels.title: Calls between services
panels.description: The orchestrator's calls to the other services that failed (5xx, no answer), per minute; p90 of their time.

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: Each copy answering, and the release it runs.
